description: This Python script sets up a file upload and analysis pipeline using Pipecat, Gemini API, and various transport configurations. It creates a sample text file, uploads it to Gemini, and manages conversation context for an AI assistant to reference the uploaded file during interactions.

classes.name: GeminiLiveLLMService
classes.description: A service class for interacting with Gemini's LLM API, supporting file uploads and other functionalities.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Represents a sequence of processing steps for the AI pipeline.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Manages execution of the pipeline, handling signals and lifecycle.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Defines a specific task with a pipeline, parameters, and timeout settings.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Holds context information for the language model, including references to uploaded files.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Aggregates context for user and assistant roles in the conversation.

methods.name: create_sample_file
methods.description: Creates a temporary sample text file for testing the Gemini File API.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Sets up and runs the AI pipeline, including file upload, context setup, and event handling.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point for the bot, initializing transport and starting the pipeline.
